name: Blinka
long_description:
Blinka is banking for US companies operating globally.

Our customers incorporate in the US but run their operations, teams, and vendors from other countries. They use Blinka as their primary operating account.

With Blinka, companies can:

- Open a USD business account without being in the US.
- Send money abroad without the usual 4–5% FX fees.
- Earn yield on treasuries.
- Issue global corporate cards with 1.5% cash back and 0 international fees.
- Manage their financial operations with our AI tools.

launches.title: Blinka: The banking platform designed for global companies
launches.body:
Blinka is building US banking for international businesses.

<https://youtu.be/J5IV-OPcGZo>

**The problem**\
My brother Sebastian and I kept hearing the same story from founders. They incorporate in the US, apply for a business account, and get rejected because they aren’t physically here. The few who do get approved pay fees on every international transfer, lose 4–5% on FX, and still can’t easily pay their team and vendors back home.

**What Blinka does**\
Blinka is the primary operating account for US companies run from anywhere in the world:

* **Open a US account remotely.** No US address or in-person visit required.
* **Get paid in USD.** Receive money from investors and customers into FDIC-insured accounts\*.
* **Send money abroad without the FX markup.** We route cross-border payments over stablecoin rails, so you skip the 4–5% fees and multi-day delays. Your balances and US payments stay in fiat.
* **Earn yield on idle cash.** Treasury lets you earn up to 4% yield.
* **Global corporate cards** with 0 international fees and up to 1.5% cash back.
* Concierge service: Get Visa infinite cards that come with our concierge support including airport to hotel transportation in flights booked with our cards.

**Our ask**

* If you’re a founder running a US company from outside the US, sign up at [blinka.co](http://blinka.co). We’ll get you onboarded quickly.
* If you know founders like this, or accountants, law firms or incorporation services who work with them, please intro us at [jp@blinka.co](mailto:jp@blinka.co).
